needed.suggestion: Construct a paved, continuous footway on the left side, separated from the carriageway by a kerb.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is an unpaved dirt shoulder with no constructed sidewalk or path.

needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a central refuge island to provide a safe place for residents to cross.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the road in either direction.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility for all road users at night.
